title: The mountain radio room
alt: A radio operator holds a wired microphone and adjusts a console while snow blows past the window.
description: A dense equipment scene with two distinct hand actions and contrasting interior and exterior light.
prompt: A cinematic interior photograph of a remote emergency radio room during a snowstorm. One adult operator in a dark sweater sits at a desk facing a large analogue radio console, with one hand on a clearly attached control knob and the other holding a radio microphone whose cable connects to the console. A wall map has pinned coloured routes without legible text; a frosted window reveals a wind-battered antenna mast outside. Warm lamp, dense equipment, coherent cables and hardware, realistic hands and face, no readable words.
